plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-12 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Exercise Science program page and its linked official degree map workbook, 'Exercise Science Degree Maps (2026-2027)', 'Exercise Science (Campus)' tab, last updated/reviewed July 31, 2026. Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. Every term's courses sum to the map's printed term total (15/15/14/16/15/15/14/16) and the plan to the catalog's printed BS degree total of 120. BS-only program: the catalog prints a single line, Total Credits, BS Degree: 120; no BA option, no combined BA/BS total and no 'with Licensure' line is printed, and the map carries no foreign-language note. The catalog's BS Degree Requirement is 12 credits (Math or Science minimum requirement), with a printed note that a portion may be met by fulfilling the General Education Core and Breadth Areas; the map does not label BS courses separately. The catalog's General Education block prints only Core Course Requirements (12+ credits) and Breadth Area Requirements (16+ credits) with 'See General Education for course options'; the map's GE rows are recorded as printed. The catalog's Free Electives section prints no fixed figure (the total is determined by the General Education courses taken, degree type, additional credits earned and prerequisite courses needed); the map's free rows total 40 credits (37 free + 3 free upper-division), recorded as printed. Cross-check: the catalog's Exercise Science Curriculum totals 49-58 credits (Core Requirements 36-37 + Biology Requirements 4 or 12 + Exercise Science Electives 9), and the map exercises exactly 58: the Core at 37 (its 17 listed courses itemize to 37, the top of the printed 36-37 heading, and every one appears on the map), Biology Group B at 12 (BIOL 1610/1615, BIOL 2320/2325, BIOL 2420/2425; Group A, BIOL 1020/1025 at 4 credits, is not exercised; the catalog also prints online lab alternatives BIOL 2323 and BIOL 2423 for the Group B anatomy and physiology labs), and the Electives at 9 (three 3-credit major upper-division elective slots). The map's Fall Year 1 'GE Quantitative Literacy*' row prints no course number; it is recorded as a generic GE choice slot. Program information printed in the catalog: all courses must be passed with a C- (1.7) or better to count in the major; PE 1543 must either be taken or a current card of completion held at graduation (the map marks it '**'). Catalog titles are recorded where the map abbreviates (e.g. 'Athletic Training & Sports Medicine' for KIN 2880, 'Sports & Exercise Biomechanics' for KIN 3060, 'Research Methods & Stats in Exercise Science' for KIN 4020, 'Exercise Testing & Prescription' for KIN 4040). GE and elective rows printed without course codes are recorded as choice slots with synthetic codes.

courses.choice_note: Printed in the degree map as 'KIN/NFS/PE Major Upper-division Elective*'. Carries the catalog's Exercise Science Electives block (complete 9 credits): KIN 4070 - Advanced Exercise Physiology, KIN 4080 - Obesity and Weight Management, KIN 4100 - ECG Interpretation, KIN 4400 - Evaluation of Musculoskeletal Injuries, KIN 4410 - Therapeutic Exercise and Rehabilitation, KIN 4450 - Therapeutic Modalities, KIN 4800 - Studies in Exercise Sciences, NFS 3020 - Nutrition as Related to Fitness and Sports, PE 4740 - Coaching Leadership and Administration, PE 4750 - Psycho-Social Aspects of Athletics (3 credits each). The catalog's Internship Option (KIN 4890 - Internship or KIN 4895 - Fitness Testing Internship, 1-8 credits each; either course, not both, with 3 credits to meet graduation requirements and no more than 3 credits toward major requirements) may also be used toward the major electives; the map does not place it.
